sloka: अस्मिन्काले तु यत्प्राप्तं तत्करिष्यामि ते हितम् ।भ्रातुरैश्वर्ययुक्तस्य खरस्य वस पार्श्वतः ।। ७.२४.३५ ॥
transliteration: asminkāle tu yatprāptaṁ tatkariṣyāmi te hitam ।bhrāturaiśvaryayuktasya kharasya vasa pārśvataḥ ।। 7.24.35 ॥

translations.english: At this time, I will do what is beneficial for you; dwell by the side of your brother Khara, who is endowed with power.
